steps.name: project-setup
steps.summary: Next.js 16 Static Export(output:export) + TypeScript strict(noUncheckedIndexedAccess) + Tailwind CSS + Jest(setupFilesAfterEnv, passWithNoTests) + ESLint 커스텀 규칙(tool 간 import 금지, lib/api 격리, no-explicit-any) 설치 완료. src/ 디렉토리 구조 생성(components/{ui,layout,seo,tools}, hooks, lib/{config,api,i18n,utils}, store, types). npm run build → out/ 생성 확인.
